<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask cli-docs`; do not edit. -->

Global flags: `-q`/`--quiet` suppresses informational output, `--no-color` (and the `NO_COLOR` environment variable) disables colour, `-w`/`--workspace <PATH>` picks the Workspace (default: the nearest ancestor containing `fauxfield.toml`) and `--json` prints machine output.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Success |
| 1 | Runtime error |
| 2 | Usage error |
| 3 | Validation failed |
| 4 | Host not running |
| 5 | Port in use |

## JSON output

With `--json` a command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout (JSON Lines for `logs --follow` and `run --log-format json`); logs and prompts go to stderr. A success is `{"schema": "fauxfield.<command>/v1", "ok": true, ...}`. A failure is `{"schema": "fauxfield.error/v1", "ok": false, "code", "message", "hint", "diagnostics"}`. Additive fields do not change the version; removing or redefining a field does.

Schema ids: `fauxfield.init/v1`, `fauxfield.validate/v1`, `fauxfield.workspace.info/v1`, `fauxfield.workspace.rename/v1`, `fauxfield.server.list/v1`, `fauxfield.server.add/v1`, `fauxfield.server.rm/v1`, `fauxfield.server.show/v1`, `fauxfield.server.rename/v1`, `fauxfield.server.enable/v1`, `fauxfield.server.disable/v1`, `fauxfield.route.list/v1`, `fauxfield.route.rm/v1`, `fauxfield.route.show/v1`, `fauxfield.route.add/v1`, `fauxfield.response.add/v1`, `fauxfield.response.set-default/v1`, `fauxfield.env.list/v1`, `fauxfield.env.use/v1`, `fauxfield.env.add/v1`, `fauxfield.var.get/v1`, `fauxfield.var.set/v1`, `fauxfield.var.unset/v1`, `fauxfield.callback.refire/v1`, `fauxfield.ws.list/v1`, `fauxfield.ws.log/v1`, `fauxfield.ws.send/v1`, `fauxfield.ws.disconnect/v1`, `fauxfield.docs.spec/v1`, `fauxfield.docs.url/v1`, `fauxfield.docs.open/v1`, `fauxfield.data.list/v1`, `fauxfield.data.show/v1`, `fauxfield.data.reset/v1`, `fauxfield.data.export/v1`, `fauxfield.data.import/v1`, `fauxfield.data.create/v1`, `fauxfield.data.delete/v1`, `fauxfield.data.rename/v1`, `fauxfield.data.generate/v1`, `fauxfield.data.refs/v1`, `fauxfield.certs.status/v1`, `fauxfield.certs.trust/v1`, `fauxfield.certs.untrust/v1`, `fauxfield.doctor/v1`, `fauxfield.render/v1`, `fauxfield.status/v1`, `fauxfield.stop/v1`, `fauxfield.logs/v1`, `fauxfield.agents.init/v1`, `fauxfield.theme.list/v1`, `fauxfield.theme.set/v1`, `fauxfield.record/v1`, `fauxfield.import/v1`, `fauxfield.export/v1`, `fauxfield.template/v1`, `fauxfield.version/v1`

## `fauxfield route add`

Add a Route to a Server file (a running host hot-reloads)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<SERVER>` | Server (ID, name, or file slug) |
| `<METHOD>` | HTTP method (case-insensitive) or ANY |
| `<PATH>` | Path or pattern (`/users/:id`, `/files/*rest`, or a regex with --match regex) |
| `--status` | Status of the default Response (100-599) |
| `--body` | Body of the default Response |
| `--body-file` | Read the default Response body from a file |
| `--from-json` | Full Route definition as JSON (same schema as the MCP `upsert_route` tool); `-` reads stdin |
| `--match` | Match mode; omitted means inferred and nothing is written |
| `--folder` | Folder (ID or unique name) |
| `--name` | Route name |
| `--priority` | Priority (higher wins; default 0) |
| `-w, --workspace` | Workspace folder (default: the nearest ancestor containing fauxfield.toml, else the current directory) |
| `--json` | Machine-readable output with a stable schema |

## `fauxfield run`

Serve a workspace headless: become the host and run its servers until stopped

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<PATH>` | Workspace folder (default: the nearest ancestor containing fauxfield.toml) |
| `--server` | Only run these Servers (ID, name, or slug); repeatable |
| `--port-offset` | Add this to every Server port |
| `--host` | Bind every Server to this host address |
| `--env` | Active Environment for this run (default: `default_environment`) |
| `--network` | Network profile for this run: none, fast-3g, slow-3g, flaky-wifi or offline |
| `--chaos` | Chaos switch: inject random faults into this fraction (0 to 1) of requests on every Server |
| `--seed` | Seed for fake and generated data on every Server, so a run repeats exactly |
| `--watch` | Hot-reload external edits (default when attached to a terminal) |
| `--no-watch` | Do not watch the workspace folder |
| `--log-format` | Request log format on stdout |

| `--since` | Only requests newer than this, e.g. `30s`, `10m`, `2h` |
| `--har` | Write the matching requests as a HAR 1.2 file instead of printing them |
| `-w, --workspace` | Workspace folder (default: the nearest ancestor containing fauxfield.toml, else the current directory) |
| `--json` | Machine-readable output with a stable schema |

## `fauxfield mcp`

Run the MCP server for agents (SPEC §11.1). Logs go to stderr; stdout is protocol-only

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<PATH>` | Workspace folder to serve tools over |
| `--transport` | Transport: stdio, unix, pipe (Windows), both, or http (streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1) |
| `--socket` | Unix socket path, or a pipe name on Windows (default: per-user runtime dir, mcp-<pid>.sock; \\\\.\\pipe\\fauxfield-mcp-<pid>) |
| `--host` | Bind address for --transport http. Only loopback is accepted (default 127.0.0.1) |
| `--port` | Port for --transport http (default: a random free port). Binds 127.0.0.1 only |
| `--allow` | Tool classes to expose: read, write, execute (default: all) |
| `--read-only` | Shorthand for --allow read |

## `fauxfield mcp scenario`

Run a scenario file against a running dev-mcp app (exit 0 pass, 1 failed step, 2 unreachable)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<FILE>` | Scenario YAML file (fixtures/scenarios/<name>.yaml) |
| `--socket` | MCP unix socket of a running `fauxfield --mcp-socket` app |
| `--out` | Write checkpoint and failure screenshots (PNG) into this folder |
| `--no-capture` | Skip screenshots (no Screen Recording permission, no display tools) |
| `--json` | Print the report as JSON |

## `fauxfield agents`

Set up coding agents (MCP client config, AGENTS.md)

## `fauxfield agents init`

Write MCP client config and an AGENTS.md section for this Workspace

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--claude` | Configure Claude Code (.mcp.json) |
| `--codex` | Configure Codex (.codex/config.toml) |
| `--cursor` | Configure Cursor (.cursor/mcp.json) |
| `-y, --yes` | Write without asking |
| `--dry-run` | Print the diff and exit; nothing is written |
| `--allow` | Tool classes the agent may use: read, write, execute |
| `--command` | Command written into the client config (default: `fauxfield`; use an absolute path when the binary is not on PATH) |
| `-w, --workspace` | Workspace folder (default: the nearest ancestor containing fauxfield.toml, else the current directory) |
| `--json` | Machine-readable output with a stable schema |
